name: inspira-images-slider
title: Images Slider
blurb: Full-screen image carousel with keyboard, touch, and optional auto-advance.
description: Controlled or uncontrolled slider that displays images with configurable direction (vertical/horizontal) and perspective. Supports keyboard/touch navigation, optional autoplay, and a render-function child for overlay content.
use_when: Displaying a portfolio, image gallery, or hero carousel with interactive controls and accessibility features.
avoid_when: Images load from untrusted sources or require rapid loading—all images must preload before rendering.
a11y: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys, focus management). Touch swipe support. Autoplay pauses on interaction. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
